title: Reviewers as executable plugins
summary: Wedge 2 of the prescription. Each reviewer spec gets a paired .mjs implementation callable via CLI + MCP + GitHub Actions. Closes Gap 4 and half of Gap 8.

strategy.decision: Each existing reviewer markdown spec at template/.claude/agents/blueprint/reviewers/ gets a paired executable .mjs. The .mjs is the single source of business logic; the .md is the canonical human description. Three invocation surfaces — CLI subcommand, MCP tool, GitHub Action — all consume the same .mjs. Error messages inject remediation instructions per Lopopolo's pattern.
strategy.why: Current reviewers are markdown specs invoked by Claude Code's Agent tool. Non-Claude consumers (Cursor, Codex, custom harnesses) have no path. CI workflows have no path. The reviewers are audit specs an agent reads; they're not lint-shaped invocable tools. Lopopolo's OpenAI team showed the production-grade pattern: custom linters with structural tests + error-injection of remediation instructions. See decisions/ADR-0002-reviewers-as-executable-plugins.md.
strategy.shipped: Reviewers exist as 9 markdown files. A Claude Code agent reads the spec, pattern-matches against the repo, returns structured output. Works in-session; fails everywhere else.
strategy.gap: From `markdown invoked by Claude Code agent only` to `executable .mjs called via CLI + MCP + GitHub Actions, with paired markdown spec as canonical description`.
strategy.question: Should the plugin SDK pattern (third-party reviewers as installable npm packages) ship in v1 or defer to v2? Deferred per the prescription — no external plugin authors yet; SDK design without a real consumer over-engineers the contract.

currentState.summary: Nine markdown reviewers covering Stage 1→2, 2→3 (variant-aware), portal-pattern-A/B conformance, Stage 5→6, and Stage 6 ship gate. The Agent tool's behavior is the only way they fire.
currentState.annotation: Each .md gets a paired .mjs at the same path. Migration order in ADR-0002 § Migration plan; portal-pattern conformance reviewers go first because they have the clearest pass/fail signal.
